name: errorlens
description: Improve highlighting of errors, warnings and other language diagnostics.

works: Diagnostic messages at the end of their lines, from any language server or linter
Only the lines near the screen are decorated, and the messages follow a scroll (Diode 0.19.1 or newer)

readme:
# Error Lens

Shows diagnostics (errors, warnings, infos) inline, at the end of the line they belong to, instead of only as squiggles and in the Problems panel.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.
